reason: I think most supplements are a waste unless a doctor tells me to take them, and nobody has. I already forget the vitamins on my counter half the time, so a box of 30 sachets would probably sit there too.
objection: No doctor has recommended magnesium to me, so I don't see why I'd pay for it. Foil sachets every day also feel like a lot of packaging waste.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me I'm low on magnesium and should take it.
